about.title: About Baali-Patro
about.whatBody: Baali-Patro (बाली-पात्रो) is a bilingual crop-and-weather calendar for five Terai districts of Nepal — Kailali, Bardiya, Banke, Kapilvastu and Rupandehi. It shows week-by-week growth stages for paddy, wheat, maize, mustard, sugarcane and potato, and pairs them with automatically generated weekly weather advisories.
about.sourcesBody: Calendar stage windows are compiled from public cropping-pattern guidance by MoALD, NARC and district agriculture offices, adjusted per district for the east-to-west monsoon gradient. Weather data comes from the Open-Meteo public forecast API using each district's headquarters coordinates.
about.limitsBody: Stage windows are indicative averages, not field prescriptions; actual dates shift with variety, irrigation and yearly climate. Advisories use simple thresholds and a 7-day horizon only. This tool does not replace local extension advice.
